Once Sentenza's repairs were well on their way, Renatus left to explore Gaea. At least that's what he told everyone why he left. Though time had past, flashbacks wielding the World Breaker was still in the forefront of his mind.

*It was just too much power.* He thought as he flew over the coasts east of Sentenza. High in the air, he noticed a familiar figure walking along the coastline.

Renatus swooped down, the Ferrum Wings glistened in the sun. During the descent, details of the figure began to emerge. The robes danced in the wind, the figure's hair was shoulder length. Renatus knew exactly who it was before landing.

"Your Grace! You've left the Nusquam!"

"I've told you many times not to call me that. Yes I was finally able to control the Nusquam. I decided afterward to take a short vacation. Walk Gaea before..." Oblitus stopped mid sentence.

"Before what, your...Oblitus." Renatus' near mistake was ignored by the God.

"Phyra nearly wiped out the Lethe. Since then, races on Gaea have flourished. Cities are booming." Oblitus turns to the sea. "At the end of days, when there isn't a mortal soul left to witness the passage of time, I shall collect the entire history of this world and move on to the next spring of life. But while I am guaranteed this prize, I do not have the patience for it."

Renatus walks just in front of Oblitus, "What are you saying?"

"The time has come for the Lethe to return. There are civilizations worth of thoughts, knowledge, life to collect. Come, Renatus. We shall return to the Nusquam to prepare."

As Oblitus walked through a wrinkle in reality, Renatus took one last look across the water. He felt uneasy about the coming events. For the first time in his relatively short life, Renatus felt divided.
